query: What signals indicate a hardware incident is in the anomaly window?

per_column.name: is_hardware
per_column.rationale: Whether the incident is hardware is a necessary precondition component of the focus but not deterministic of it (being hardware does not imply anomaly window). It carries genuine predictive signal about whether a record can be in the hardware anomaly window without fully restating the target.

per_column.name: priority_score
per_column.rationale: Priority is a legitimate external attribute known at incident time that plausibly correlates with anomalous hardware bursts (e.g., higher-priority spikes). It is not a component or function of the focus.

per_column.name: resolution_hours
per_column.rationale: Resolution time is only knowable after the incident is closed (post-outcome), so using it to predict whether the record is in the anomaly window constitutes temporal leakage relative to prediction time.

per_column.name: hw_incidents_last_7d
per_column.rationale: A rolling count of recent hardware incidents is exactly the kind of contextual, pre-outcome signal that indicates an anomalous surge. It lies outside the focus and plausibly carries strong predictive signal for anomaly windows.

per_column.name: hw_anomaly_window
per_column.rationale: This is essentially the focus variable itself (hardware anomaly window flag) restated. Its value distribution mirrors the target; using it is trivial leakage/restatement, not a predictor.

per_column.name: hw_resolution_zscore
per_column.rationale: A z-score of resolution time is derived from resolution_hours, a post-outcome quantity, and is often used to define anomalies. It leaks the outcome and is not available at prediction time.

judge.rationale: Three columns (is_hardware, priority_score, hw_incidents_last_7d) are legitimate pre-outcome predictors, with hw_incidents_last_7d providing the strongest genuine leverage for detecting anomalous hardware surges. However, half the added set is compromised: hw_anomaly_window is a near-restatement of the focus, while resolution_hours and hw_resolution_zscore are post-outcome quantities that leak. As a set, the predictive value beyond the original columns is moderate, dragged down by leakage and restatement.
